design_intent: Keep multiple working explanations visible while choosing bounded next steps from admitted evidence. The set guides investigation; it is not a terminal causal verdict.

working_hypotheses.label: Roll / web-path condition
supports: A recorded roll change can be recent context for this synthetic episode.
A coupled roll/web machine-behavior signature can make this path more informative when present.
missing: Compare roll seating and visible web path with the approved changeover reference.

working_hypotheses.label: Guide / spacing condition
supports: Presentation instability is compatible with a local guide / spacing mismatch.
Matched synthetic history has previously made this path useful to inspect.
missing: Compare the visible guide / spacing relationship with the commissioned marked reference.

working_hypotheses.label: Timing / controls relationship
supports: Timing or control behavior can produce presentation consequences.
against: Current synthetic label-feed timing evidence remains inside its supplied healthy band.
missing: Fresh timing evidence outside the commissioned envelope would raise this path's investigation priority.

next_step_principle: Prefer observation-only, reversible, low-disturbance and high-information checks before changing a setting that can mask the condition or introduce another variable.

episode_dispositions.recovered: Operating behavior stable under observed conditions

boundaries: intervention followed by improvement != proof of mechanism
episode closure = bounded operating disposition, not causal certainty
synthetic demo evidence != physical machine evidence
